title: AI Spokesperson Videos for UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Create AI spokesperson videos for UGC ads. Choose a speaking actor, add your product and write a clear line for a selfie-style product ad.
h1: AI Spokesperson Videos With a Speaking Actor
lead: Choose an adult AI actor who holds your product and speaks to camera in a familiar setting. Add one useful line, then review the voice, visuals and claims.

steps.d: Start with a clear view of the full item and its real details.
Pick a scene and delivery style that fit your product and audience.
Use accurate, supportable wording, then review the voice and visuals before publishing.

faq.q: Can an AI actor speak in a product ad?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short spoken line and the generated presenter can deliver it while showing your product.

faq.q: Can I choose the actor’s appearance and setting?
faq.a: Choose from the available adults, age ranges and scenes. The presenter may vary slightly between generated results.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is AI-generated. Do not describe the actor as a real buyer or user.

faq.q: Can an AI actor give a testimonial?
faq.a: Do not invent a customer testimonial. Use only real, authorized customer words, or write a brand-led product explanation.

faq.q: Which products work well in these videos?
faq.a: Handheld products such as skincare, apparel accessories, jewelry, pet supplies, snacks, drinks, fitness items and phone accessories are easy to show clearly.

overview.h2: Let the presenter provide context, not a testimonial
overview.p: A presenter can show a product’s size and shape in a familiar setting. Keep the item near the center of the shot, with room for its details to show.

steps.sourceAlt: Plain forest-green bottle shown fully from cap to base on a light neutral background.
steps.sourceHint: Start with a clear view of the full item.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded product image and preserve its shape, colors and label. In a parked car, an adult Latina woman holds a plain serum bottle beside her face and says: “Here is the pump detail I wanted to show.” She turns the bottle once so the pump faces the lens. Handheld front-camera chest-up framing, natural light and skin texture, slight natural sway. Sound: her voice and soft parked-car room tone; no music.

picker.title: Choose a format and setting

cards.label: Car selfie review: serum pump
cards.prompt: In a parked car, an adult creator holds the serum beside their face and says: “Here is the pump detail I wanted to show.” They turn it once toward the lens. Front-camera chest-up selfie, natural daylight, realistic skin, slight handheld sway. Sound: clear speech and soft car ambience; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Bathroom routine: moisturizer
cards.prompt: At a bright bathroom sink, an adult creator holds the moisturizer beside their cheek and says: “This is the step I do before makeup.” They pat a small amount onto one cheek. Direct-to-camera selfie, natural light, realistic skin. Sound: clear speech and quiet room tone; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Kitchen solution: skillet spatula
cards.prompt: At a home kitchen counter, an adult creator holds a silicone spatula and says: “This edge reaches along the curve of the pan.” They guide it once around a plain skillet, then face the lens. Casual phone selfie, natural window light. Sound: speech and a light pan scrape; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Living-room unboxing: earbuds
cards.prompt: In a lived-in living room, an adult creator opens a small plain box, lifts a round wireless-earbud case and says: “Let’s open the case and see what comes in the box.” Eye-level handheld chest-up shot, natural skin texture. Sound: speech and soft packaging rustle; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Podcast review: headphones
cards.prompt: At a small podcast table, an adult creator holds plain over-ear headphones and says: “Here are three details I can show: the ear cups, hinge and button placement.” They turn the headphones once. Front-camera medium close-up, soft room light. Sound: speech and quiet room tone; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Cafe try-on: everyday cardigan
cards.prompt: At a cafe window seat, an adult creator wears a plain cardigan and says: “Same cardigan, three layers: tee, button-down and tank.” They gesture to the neckline and sleeve. Casual front-camera selfie, natural window light. Sound: speech and low cafe ambience; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Gym demo: shaker bottle
cards.prompt: In a practical gym, an adult creator holds a plain shaker and says: “One squeeze shows how the cap opens with one hand.” They press the lid once and hold the bottle still. Chest-up front-camera view, natural skin, soft daylight. Sound: speech and a light shaker rattle; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Office setup: phone stand
cards.prompt: At a home-office desk, an adult creator opens a folding phone stand and says: “If your phone keeps sliding on calls, this stand holds the angle in place.” They set a phone into the cradle. Handheld eye-level selfie, window light. Sound: speech and a light hinge click; no music, text or logos.

uses.d: An adult presenter speaks to camera while holding a useful everyday product at a clear scale.
A direct-to-camera line makes a product feature easy to follow in a feed.
